estimates.title: DiD estimates
estimates.description: Difference-in-differences coefficients for every specification (real and synthetic data), with clustered SEs, CIs, randomization-inference p (preferred design), wild-bootstrap p and simulated truth. From model_results.json.

event_study.title: Event-study coefficients
event_study.description: Event-study coefficients by months relative to May 2024 for the exempt-area, room-type and cross-market designs, plus the reference point (0). From model_results.json.

headline.title: Headline KPIs
headline.description: Before/after figures for the headline metrics (covered, never-covered and Salt Spring listings, Vancouver incl. same-season, multi-host share, registry numbers and 'Exempt' claims, CPI rent), computed from the panel; Victoria baseline Aug 2023, others Sep 2023.

macro.title: CPI, rates and vacancy
macro.description: Monthly StatCan CPI (rented accommodation, all items), Bank of Canada policy rate and CMHC vacancy / 2-bedroom rent (each survey from its publication) for Victoria, Vancouver and Ottawa. From str_rent_panel.

nbhd_change.title: Neighbourhood change
nbhd_change.description: Per neighbourhood: active entire homes at the last pre-announcement snapshot vs Jun 2026, principal-residence coverage, multi-host and licence-number shares. From str_nbhd_panel.

nbhd_series.title: Neighbourhood trends
nbhd_series.description: Active entire-home listings per neighbourhood and complete snapshot, Victoria CRD and Vancouver. From str_nbhd_panel.

pretrend.title: Pre-trend tests
pretrend.description: Joint Wald tests on pre-announcement leads for each event study, randomization-inference p for the exempt-area design (three control areas), and the differential linear pre-trend. From model_results.json.

rent_bound.title: Mechanical rent bound
rent_bound.description: Upper bound on rent effects implied by units removed relative to renter households, by city. From model_results.json.

rent_models.title: Rent regressions
rent_models.description: Rent models: BC vs Ottawa CPI rent DiD, reduced form, macro controls and rent on STR supply, Driscoll-Kraay SEs (descriptive: three cities). From model_results.json.

snapshots.title: Snapshot coverage
snapshots.description: Every Inside Airbnb snapshot used: date, listing count, completeness vs neighbouring snapshots, the truncation flag and the share of never-seen listing IDs. From snapshot_months.

supply.title: Listings by market
supply.description: Active Inside Airbnb listings per observed snapshot, by city and room type, with multi-listing-host share, provincial registry-number share and 'Exempt'-claim share. From str_rent_panel (live, observed months).

victoria_split.title: Victoria covered vs exempt
victoria_split.description: Victoria CRD active listings summed over neighbourhoods covered by the principal-residence rule, never covered (Juan de Fuca, Southern Gulf Islands), or Salt Spring Island (exempt until its Nov 2025 opt-in), per snapshot and room type. From str_nbhd_panel.
